name: Search Folders
description: Windows MDM settings in the Search Folders category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Keep Search Folders in Exchange online (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting allows you to specify the number of days to keep a Search Folder active when running in online mode. After a Search Folder has not been accessed for the specified number of days, it becomes dormant and no longer remains up-to-date with current contents of folders (viewing the Search Folder makes it active again and restarts the timer).

If you enable this policy setting, you may specify the number of days to keep a Search Folder active when running in online mode.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, then Search Folders always remain dormant.

properties.name: Keep Search Folders offline (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting allows you to specify the number of days to keep a Search Folder active when running in offline or cached mode. After a Search Folder has not been accessed for the specified number of days, it becomes dormant and no longer remains up-to-date with current contents of folders (viewing the Search Folder makes it active again and restarts the timer).

If you enable this policy setting, you may specify the number of days to keep a Search Folder active when running in offline mode.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, then Search Folders always remain dormant.

properties.name: Maximum Number of Online Search Folders per mailbox (User)
properties.description: Specifies the maximum number of Search Folders that run on the Exchange server. The number of Search Folders running on the client computer is not affected.

properties.name: Specify days to keep folders alive in Exchange online mode: (User)
Specify days to keep folders alive in offline or cached mode: (User)
